## Question and falsification

What is the hypothesis, null and result that would falsify the claim?
Is this exploratory or confirmatory? Have evaluation results already been viewed?

## Data and baseline

Name source/terms, units, currency, geography, horizon and a simple baseline.
Disclose missing data, vintage/release timing and redistribution restrictions.

## Evaluation and budget

Define splits, metrics, costs, trial accounting, parameter search and resource limits.
No paid feed or compute authorization is implied by this issue.

## Proposed contribution

What bounded artifact or test will the PR deliver? Include the freeze plan before
confirmatory evaluation. No credentials or private account data in this issue.
